title: OrionMoE-v1.0: A Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Tabular In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20418v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis Transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts along the feature axis, with routing decisions informed by both individual feature representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. OrionMoE-Small is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a struct

translated_title: OrionMoE-v1.0：用于表格上下文学习的混合专家基础模型
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型能够在无需针对特定任务进行参数更新的情况下，通过从带标签的支持表中预测未见观测值来实现上下文学习。尽管近年来取得了一定进展，但大多数现有方法仍依赖于在特征和数据集上应用相同变换的密集架构。我们提出了OrionMoE-Small，这是一个紧凑的表格基础模型，它将分布感知表示与基于数据集条件的稀疏混合专家计算相结合。OrionMoE-Small建立在双轴Transformer架构之上，沿特征轴选择性地激活专家，其路由决策同时参考了单个特征表示和更广泛的数据集上下文。这种设计使模型能够在异构表格问题上自适应地分配计算资源，同时保留跨任务的共享计算路径。OrionMoE-Small完全在由结构（原文此处截断）生成的合成分类任务上进行预训练。
tldr: 提出了OrionMoE-Small，一个将分布感知表示与数据集条件稀疏混合专家计算相结合的紧凑型表格基础模型，通过双轴Transformer沿特征轴自适应激活专家，实现异构表格任务的高效上下文学习。
en_tdlr: OrionMoE-Small is a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation, adaptively activating experts along the feature axis through a dual-axis Transformer to enable efficient in-context learning across heterogeneous tabular tasks.
